"""A listener of ``WorkerStartedEvent``."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import final

from xtr_event_dispatcher import as_event_listener
from xtr_messenger.event import WorkerStartedEvent

__all__ = ["ReportWorkerStartedListener"]


@final
class ReportWorkerStartedListener:
    """Reacts to ``WorkerStartedEvent``."""

    @as_event_listener(WorkerStartedEvent)
    async def on_worker_started_event(self, event: WorkerStartedEvent) -> None:
        """Handle ``event``."""
        del event  # Replace with what reacting to the event does.
